candidates.title: Infrastructure Inspection Officer
candidates.location: Aberfeldie VIC (188 Holmes Rd), field based across Moonee Valley
candidates.content_text: Moonee Valley City Council careers board (Oracle), requisition 11304, read 15 Oct 2026 AEDT. Fixed term 12 month, part time 3 days per week, Band 5 from $85,114.74 pa pro rata plus 12% super. Field based programmed and reactive inspections of roads, footpaths, shared paths, drainage interfaces, bridges and traffic signs under the Road Management Plan; identify and record defects, determine maintenance responses, issue and monitor work orders, inspect civil construction, maintenance and reinstatement works against approved drawings, permits and Council standards, keep inspection records, photographs and asset data, prepare inspection and compliance reports, liaise with residents, contractors and utilities. Skills and experience: qualification in civil engineering, civil construction, infrastructure, asset management or related discipline, and/or relevant demonstrated experience; experience in infrastructure inspection, civil construction, maintenance, asset management or related field; understanding of municipal road and path assets and risk based inspection; ability to interpret drawings, specifications, permits and construction standards; experience with asset management systems, mobile inspection technology, mapping systems and digital record keeping; organisation; communication; current Victorian Driver Licence; White Card or ability to obtain. Apply through the online system with a response to the Key Selection Criteria per the Application Guide. Enquiries: Adam Meilak, Coordinator Infrastructure and Public Realm, AMeilak@mvcc.vic.gov.au, 03 9243 1049. Checks: criminal history, pre-employment medical, driver licence, references, right to work. Closes 11:00pm Friday 23 October 2026. Also syndicated on publicroles.com.au.
candidates.apply_instructions: Apply Now on the Moonee Valley careers board (requisition 11304) before 11:00pm Friday 23 October 2026, with resume, cover letter and a written response to the Key Selection Criteria following the Council Application Guide.

candidates.title: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil engineer or civil designer (Kilmore or Shepparton VIC)
candidates.location: Shepparton, Kilmore, Echuca or Wangaratta VIC
candidates.content_text: Chris Smith & Associates careers page (read 15 Oct 2026 AEDT): 'Be part of a growing, regional firm with long-term career opportunities ... Apply now by sending your resume to admin@csmith.com.au.' Open listings are Land Surveyor and Licensed Surveyor; no civil engineering or design vacancy is listed, so this is a speculative enquiry. Home page: planning, surveying and engineering services across regional Victoria and Southern NSW; offices in Shepparton, Kilmore, Echuca and Wangaratta. Services page, Civil Engineering: 'Subdivision design and construction management, including road works, drainage, services etc.', retention basin and wetland design, preparation of as-constructed data (D-Spec, R-Spec), intersection and road widening design, DTP (Vic Roads) prequalified. About page: about 25 staff; team lists Tom Kerrins (Manager Engineering), Senior Engineering Designers, a Civil Engineer and a Construction Manager. Project pages: Lauriston Estate, a 182-lot low density subdivision at Grace Road, Shepparton North (design and documentation of roads, drainage, water, sewer and utilities, ongoing site supervision and quality control); Kilmore Recycled Water pump station and 4.4 km pipeline for Goulburn Valley Water (2021 to 2024).
candidates.apply_instructions: Email resume to admin@csmith.com.au as invited on https://www.csmith.com.au/careers. Label clearly as a speculative enquiry.
supported_contributions: Road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, plus Before You Dig Australia enquiries, from the Advanced Diploma (February 2026)
Site inspections, quality checks and drawing reviews from Philippines project-in-charge work in 2019
Site reports, material records and progress reports from residential subdivision finishing works as a field engineer 2019 to 2020
